calculation.description: In broad equity-market stress, rank 10-day trend positively after inverse-volatility scaling; in calmer regimes invert the signal to favor short-term relative reversal. Breadth is computed from the first eight equity indices and lagged one completed day.

dependencies: breadth of 000300.SH, SPX, HSI, N225, SX5E, 000688.SH, SOX, NDX

validation.regime_notes: Strongest tested threshold. 10-day IC/ICIR pass both benchmark gates; 1d, 3d, and 5d ICs were also positive. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative sizing and rolling revalidation.
